answer: Resist Sybils with a basket weaver's willow weaving. A newcomer weaves 20 baskets over 24 days, each basket's 120 willow rods counted and tension-checked by 2 weavers from different workshops and logged before the water test. A leaking basket loses its credit and freezes rewards for 14 days, and three leaks wipe the whole tally. A raven courier carries the signed tally in sable ink from each vertex of the workshop. Faking 1,000 agents needs 20,000 baskets and 40,000 checks, willow at  a basket, about 0,000 before one reward. Trust grows like a woven basket, one true rod at a time.
